coverage.detail: 1470 unique Amazon items from 10 queries, 136 result pages walked. Q1 'Ender 3 hotend kit': 188 items/12p (p13 load failed x2: net::ERR_FAILED); Q2 'Ender 3 thermistor 100K': 279/20p; Q3 'Micro Swiss Ender 3 hotend': 200/14p; Q4 'Ender 3 thermistor heater cartridge kit': 285/21p; Q5 '5015 blower fan 24V': 201/13p (p14 failed x2: net::ERR_FAILED); Q6 'Winsinn 5015 fan': 64/4p (p5 failed x2: net::ERR_FAILED); Q7 'dual gear extruder Ender 3': 96/6p (p7 failed x2: net::ERR_FAILED); Q8 'BLTouch Ender 3 kit': 174/11p (p12 failed x2: net::ERR_FAILED); Q9 'CR Touch Ender 3': 283/21p; Q10 'Creality CR Touch auto bed leveling kit': 202/14p. No captchas served; no 429/bot-wall; page-N failures were transient net::ERR_FAILED (network blip class), each retried twice per protocol. Bed-leveling items carry title-derived (unverified) probe signals: 71 genuine BLTouch / 143 genuine CR Touch / 39 clone / 249 unknown; phase 3 decides kit completeness.
53 unique items (2 auto_bed_leveling), 5 queries, browser route via residential proxy

2 unique items (0 auto_bed_leveling), 5 queries, browser route via residential proxy; BLTouch/CR Touch/5015-blower queries re-run to rule out timeouts - genuinely thin
Cloudflare challenge on https://www.microcenter.com/search/search_results.aspx?Ntt=Ender+3+hotend (HTTP 403; challenge text present); Steve manual clear is the tiebreaker
